name: Mosaic Retrieve Rank Reason Lab Contract

ownership.source_repository: Lab timing, retrieval examples, application surfaces, evaluation assertions, and the gap seams with their broken bodies (scripts/lab_state.py).
ownership.workshop_studio: Participant instructions, provisioning-time gap injection, and code-editor exercises.

memory.question: Can Mosaic remember Alex’s preferences across conversations?
memory.story: Alex comes back another day. Recall what matters to him, then check the catalog again before recommending a product.
memory.placement: After the required hour; extraction time is asynchronous and has no promised duration.
memory.opening_message: I prefer a 27-inch monitor with USB-C laptop charging, so I can run code and read docs side by side with fewer cables.
memory.request: Which monitor would suit the way I work at home?
memory.changed_request: For this request, I want a 32-inch monitor, not my usual 27-inch preference. USB-C laptop charging is optional today. Compare suitable monitors and cite their screen size and connection specifications.
checkpoints: Save Alex’s message and inspect its event ID. Wait for an actual extracted preference record before continuing.
Start a new session. Keep the same actor, with no earlier conversation events or copied shortlist.
Find relevant memories and ask the same question with memory on and off. Inspect record IDs actually read; different wording alone is not proof.
Follow the new Aurora search and resolve each product citation. Memory supplies preferences, never product facts.
Submit the changed request. Verify the new size takes priority even when the older preference is recalled.
Start fresh as another actor. Alex’s records must be unavailable, including when the earlier session ID is supplied.

missions.title: Lab 1 - Build hybrid retrieval

participant_edit.task: Restore the trigram CTE and its candidate channel in search_hybrid_rrf.
participant_edit.broken_state: Alex transposes J3 to 3J in listing ID B07G95TJ3P. Exact terms and the bounded meaning-search list miss that listing. Close-spelling search finds it, but its disconnected channel prevents it reaching fusion.
participant_edit.fixed_state: The restored close-spelling channel admits Bose QuietComfort 35 II, product 1277987, with trigram rank 1. It was final rank 1 in repeated verification.
observe_before: HTTP 200 with other headphones; the intended Bose listing 1277987 is absent from the first 10 results.
The saved combined pool omits 1277987 and reports trigram_in_pool = 0.
observe_after: The identical B07G95T3JP request returns listing B07G95TJ3P (1277987).
The target has a trigram rank and contribution; its FTS and semantic ranks remain null.
All products satisfy the headphones category and electronics domain filters.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: Why can related headphones be wrong for an exact-product request, and why could reranking not recover the missing listing?

missions.expected_outcome: Recover the exact Bose listing B07G95TJ3P from a transposed identifier, with a close-spelling rank and contribution. Other headphones are wrong identities for this request; no claim is made that they lack noise cancellation.

missions.title: Lab 2 - Fuse, rerank, and inspect
missions.discover_label: Keep the right monitor in the shortlist

participant_edit.task: Restore the reciprocal-rank contribution formula 1 / (k + rank).
participant_edit.broken_state: Collapsed contributions erase positions within each search. On the fixed request, the 50-product cutoff drops the Dell U2720Q before reranking; a 1440p HP Z27n appears among the final results for a 4K request.
participant_edit.fixed_state: Correct contributions retain Dell U2720Q (1408222). In repeated verification it moved from combined position 24 to final position 1; its source record states 3840 x 2160 and up to 90W USB-C power delivery.
observe_before: HTTP 200 with plausible monitors, but Dell U2720Q 1408222 is absent from the combined pool and top 10.
A source position greater than 1 receives 1 / (k + 1), tying products with different source positions.
Inspect the HP Z27n title: 1440p does not satisfy the requested 4K resolution.
observe_after: Each contribution equals 1 / (k + source_rank); at least one inspected source rank is greater than 1.
Dell U2720Q enters the combined list and reaches the declared final shortlist. Record your own combined and final positions.
Repeat the identical request and verify the same before-reranking order.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: Why could the reranker not select the Dell before the repair, and why need its combined position not be first?

missions.expected_outcome: Restore 1 / (k + source_rank), keep the Dell U2720Q in the bounded combined list, and let reranking compare its 4K and up-to-90W specifications with Alex’s request.

missions.title: Lab 3 - Build the retrieval agent
missions.query: I am finishing my home office. Check the Dell U2720Q (B0939N79Y8) for a 27-inch 4K screen and USB-C charging up to 90W, and the Steelcase Gesture (B01NAKXH73) for adjustable lumbar support and movable arms. Search each product separately, compare their fit for these needs, and explain what the specifications and available reviews do and do not establish. Cite the supporting records and explain the ranking of one search.

participant_edit.task: Attach retrieved evidence IDs to agent state by product before synthesis.
participant_edit.broken_state: Evidence is returned to the model but grounded synthesis cannot resolve it, so the agent refuses an unsupported recommendation.
participant_edit.fixed_state: Comparison and synthesis consume retrieved evidence records and return citation IDs that resolve to those records.
observe_before: The agent invokes retrieval and evidence tools but cannot create an answer of record.
POST /api/agent/answer returns HTTP 503 instead of an unsupported recommendation.
No citation is presented as valid.
observe_after: POST /api/agent/answer returns HTTP 200 with at least two retrieved recommendations.
Two focused search_products receipts independently cover the monitor and chair target classes before comparison and synthesis.
The explained retrieval event persists a non-empty EXPLAIN (ANALYZE, BUFFERS, SETTINGS, FORMAT JSON) plan from the production SQL path.
Every citation evidence_id resolves exactly to a real evidence record for a recommended product.
participant_edit.checkpoint_question: What did the agent decide, and what remained deterministic retrieval and evidence behavior?

missions.expected_outcome: A bounded, read-only agent runs focused searches for both requested product classes, uses typed comparison, ranking, evidence, and synthesis tools within application-owned citation scope, and produces citations that resolve to real evidence records.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Preserve the exact listing
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: The correctly spelled ASIN retrieves the intended Bose listing with an Exact terms contribution.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Describe the monitor need
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Inspect which methods retrieve the Dell when the request describes screen resolution and laptop charging rather than a model name.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Keep the brand requirement
supporting_checks.query: Bose QuietComfort 35 series II wireless noise cancelling headphones
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: The model-name search retains the Bose target. Every saved candidate and displayed result stays within the Bose headphones filter; a related product from another brand is ineligible.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Compare display specifications
supporting_checks.query: Dell U2720Q versus Dell SE2717H monitor resolution USB-C charging
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Retrieve both named Dell monitors. Their records distinguish 3840 x 2160 from 1920 x 1080. Do not infer equivalent USB-C charging, current price or stock.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Keep brand filters ahead of scoring
supporting_checks.discover_label: Keep brand filters ahead of scoring
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: The same monitor need, restricted to Dell, excludes HP and Lenovo before reranking. Inspect both saved candidates and served results.

supporting_checks.title: Checkpoint - Separate listening from microphone evidence
supporting_checks.query: For Bose QuietComfort 35 II B07G95TJ3P, what do the specifications and available reviews support about noise cancellation and clear calls? Cite the records, and say when review evidence does not establish microphone performance.
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: Resolve specification and sampled-review citations for the Bose listing. Listening noise cancellation does not establish microphone call quality; disclose the evidence gap.

supporting_checks.title: Tune the HNSW operating point
supporting_checks.expected_outcome: A measured configuration records recall, latency, index size, build time, extension version, and filter selectivity.

guided_requests.label: Plan my workspace
guided_requests.notice: One request, two product needs. Follow the separate monitor and chair searches, their filters, and the evidence behind the final choices.

guided_requests.label: Check the sources
guided_requests.query: For Bose QuietComfort 35 II B07G95TJ3P, what do the specifications and available reviews support about noise cancellation and clear calls? Cite the records, and say when review evidence does not establish microphone performance.
guided_requests.notice: Compare the catalog specification with sample review evidence about fit. A general review does not prove every advertised benefit.

requests.label: Clearer calls
requests.query: I take video calls from home and need headphones that keep my voice clear despite background noise.
requests.notice: Alex needs the other person to hear him clearly. Follow microphone performance through retrieval and ranking; listening noise cancellation alone does not prove call clarity.

requests.label: Comfortable days
requests.query: a chair that keeps me comfortable through long coding sessions, with support I can adjust to fit me
requests.notice: Follow Alex’s need for adjustable support from finding products through ranking and a comparison grounded in product details.

requests.label: More screen space
requests.query: a 27 inch 4K desk monitor for code and docs side by side, with USB-C video and 90W laptop charging
requests.notice: Alex wants room for code and reference material, with fewer cables on his desk. Compare screen size, resolution and connections. Check the specifications for USB-C video and charging separately.
